name: Terraform
description: Declarative infrastructure-as-code tool for provisioning cloud and on-prem resources.
rationale: Default IaC tool across all managed environments.

name: Pulumi
description: Infrastructure-as-code authored in a general-purpose language instead of a domain-specific syntax.
rationale: Acceptable where a client mandates a general-purpose language over HCL.

name: Ansible
description: Agentless configuration management and orchestration over SSH.
rationale: Bounded trial on one managed estate; was Assess last edition.

name: Chef
description: Agent-based configuration management using a Ruby DSL.
rationale: Superseded by the Ansible trial outcome; migration owned and scheduled.

name: Kubernetes
description: Container orchestration platform for deploying, scaling, and managing containerised workloads.
rationale: Default for all new containerised workloads.

name: Trunk-Based Development
description: Developers integrate small, frequent changes into a shared trunk.
rationale: Default branching model for managed delivery teams.

name: Legacy Ticketing-Driven Change
description: Manual, ticket-driven change approval replacing automated policy gates.
rationale: Declined during the 2026 review — see the domain ADR.
